subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: What permanent contract should OpenClaw use for Docker-hosted Gateway sandbox bind sources in Docker-outside-of-Docker deployments?
rationale: The fix is not just a local path rewrite: it changes the sandbox host-path exposure boundary and the operator setup contract for Docker installs, so automation should not choose the security model alone.

options.title: Security-Reviewed Host Mapping
options.body: Add a single core host-path mapping contract that validates mapped sources before Docker receives them, covers workspace/skill/browser mounts, updates schema/docs/doctor as needed, and requires live DooD proof.

options.title: Require Identical Host/Container Paths
options.body: Document and enforce the current parity requirement with setup and doctor checks, avoiding path translation but making unsupported Docker volume layouts fail clearly.

options.title: Leave Docker Sandbox Limited
options.body: Keep DooD sandboxing unsupported for non-parity volume layouts and document the limitation instead of expanding the sandbox bind-source contract now.

recommendation.title: Security-Reviewed Host Mapping
recommendation.body: Add a single core host-path mapping contract that validates mapped sources before Docker receives them, covers workspace/skill/browser mounts, updates schema/docs/doctor as needed, and requires live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the canonical cluster signal and have recent history across sandbox Docker/runtime and docs surfaces.
